coverage.case_status: All ten unexecuted; no native admission, catalog census, Model, proof, result or timing exists. All intended as classical theorem candidates; logical intent is author judgment, not a Native-certified status.
finite_search_limits: Frozen target-free input/target subterms plus explicit variable term for every initial binder. Because every target here is closed, only closed subterms plus binder variables enter the fixed pool. No arbitrary fresh ground-term closure.

Two UI catalog construction snapshots, not a global limit of two UI inference steps. Later capture-renamed names may enter variable metadata but do not grow the term pool. No percase source substitution is evaluated here.

Current generated equality schemes use one atomic-template layer and closed operand pairs from existing equality subformulas; no general equational saturation. Equality specimens use closed ground operands deliberately within that declared syntax lane.

Native tautology rule is broader than finite basis admission. Composition/contraposition may lack required intermediate propositional formulas in current subformula/UI/EQ catalog; no bridge formulas/axioms/helper lemmas are supplied and no finite-grammar impossibility is asserted.

All four old formula-family templates and all newly natively admitted specializations retained without filtering; derived physical arity covers every admitted interface. Grammar,registry,query,memory or search stops remain outcomes.
coverage.novelty_scope: Eight primary input AST shapes differ from each other and the declared three development shapes under bound-variable/symbol renaming. Two controls intentionally share parent shapes. No all-history logical independence or blind sampling claim.
scope_exclusions: No official TPTP problem IDs/content, CASC ratings or external solver results.
No truth/eigenvariable/substitution/Native/template/codec evaluation, benchmark trials or handwritten proof command sequence.
No additional rule, axiom schema, natural-number induction or Euclidean/Hilbert geometry theory.

No current cold activation compatibility: existing frozen cold/outer bind the earlier structural declaration and six selected-receiver subjects. A new genuinely reviewed declaration/selection/closure/cohort/grant composition is required.
supported_input_lane: Closed untyped first-order terms var/fun with declared finite arity; constants are zero-arity function applications.
Native formula tags bot/not/imp/and/or/all/pred/eq are available; this suite uses pred/eq/imp/not/all, constants and one unary function.
All named axioms and targets closed; schemas empty, no open root assumptions or predicate/function variables. Same exact receiver envelope,12rows,2catalog UI rounds.

Native supports axiom/tautology/refl/instantiate/eq_subst/mp/generalize/block and additional rules; current search catalog is narrower. No primitive exists, PA/Hilbert/geometry/typed or arithmetic assertion is introduced.

unresolved_cases.reason: Nested binary universal instance/argument-order/capture catalog may incur substantial setup/registry cost; no full catalog computed.
Shared-premise branching and multiple quantified premises may exceed finite12-row/macro/domain/resource lane; no proof length or solvability claim.
Hypothetical composition tests missing intermediate propositional synthesis coverage, not only exploration order.
Negative polarity/contraposition tests finite propositional bridge coverage, not only exploration order.

design.authorship: Reviewer authored a separate qualification harness and prior Source/data reviews, not the current search engines. This is new synthetic INPUT authorship, not independent own-input validation or a new proof-search implementation. Distinct Source/declaration review required.

benchmark_practice_mapping.application: We use explicit axioms plus a target conjecture, but our JSON envelope is not TPTP syntax and no official library problem was imported.

Freeze general strategies and test inputs before trials, retain complete acceptable solution output under declared bounds, group near-duplicate controls and disclose timing/measurement scope. This is methodological guidance, not CASC compliance/eligibility/ranking.

Require source-bound acyclic ordered premise links and final target/proof provenance; any future external transformation/proof format needs separate validation. Our native proof format remains distinct.
Keep theorem/proof acceptance separate from no-success reasons such as timeout,incompleteness,error. Our retained resource diagnostic is not automatically an SZS success or countermodel certificate.

method_comparison.current_symbolic_control: Chronological finite proof-word prefix control over same compiled grammar/ordered prior ports, no GCTS points during its search; common point model construction and verification remain charged. It is not a complete dedicated FOL saturation prover or no-encoding-cost baseline.
method_comparison.future_external_control: A separately reviewed TPTP translation and an established external FOL prover can test mathematical/corpus coverage. Such a prover has a different calculus/search space. Charge translation/library/preprocessing/proof production and independently validate accepted proof/translation; do not call it an exact finite-grammar control or invoke it now.
method_comparison.knowledge: Same full spec, complete compiler/admitted guards, full four-template prior policy and complete registered definitions/interfaces/native_blocks, full Model/initial state in every arm.
method_comparison.operation_units: Point placement attempts and symbolic prefix extensions are different units; same numeric cap is a profile choice, not equal computational work or a speed ratio. Native queries/microsteps and complete wall/resource costs reported separately.

profile.conservative_peak_scope: Exact scientific worker+CPP wait4 high-water sum, may doublecount and excludes observer/parent; posthoc bound not live aggregate cap.
profile.timing: Whole setup/import/compile/native-registry/full model+all candidates/search/native final/full point/output/reader/inverse/custody charged;180work/210overall. Same compact representation/common23-module setup initially in all methods.

prospective_schedule_requirements: Root separately freezes complete allcase/method subjects and unique fresh dirs/oncegrants after independent input/Source/composition review. No slots/grants/actuals are created here.

Use same strategy/profile for every input, no case IDs/titles/expected solutions in policies or special branches. Method order should be balanced/counterbalanced prospectively, with all seeds and any repetitions fixed before outcomes.
No handwritten proofs/rowcommands/routes/registered instance IDs in inputs. Posthoc line-by-line human proofs must be generated only from discovered admitted output.

All agents idle during Root sequential measurement windows; preserve failures and full records. Any Source repair or later larger-budget study gets a distinct prospective version, not relabeling old runs.

split_policy.blindness: Prospective held-fixed synthetic evaluation, not a hidden blind test, random sample or official benchmark. Architecture and development results were known to author; formulas become visible on publication.
split_policy.development: All prior arithmetic/semantic cases, especially commutation/diagonal/curried and previously published coverage probes; prior outcomes were known and used only to exclude these inputs from the new structural list.
split_policy.evaluation: Ten fixed inputs/eight groups authored before any of these cases were executed. Agent selected cases without consulting the parallel current-search diagnosis outcomes. No anticipated success/census/resource filter.
split_policy.promotion: After any outcome is used for tuning/mining, mark that case/group as development in subsequent claims and require a new independently fixed evaluation corpus. Preserve every old outcome/version.
split_policy.training: Only preexisting declared training/development proofs and frozen prior four-family library. Do not mine/train/tune on any new-suite outcome before cohort closure.

success_and_reporting.all_outcomes: Retain input rejection, compile/registry/native space/timeout, model/transport/whole-point/resource failures and search UNKNOWN. Bounded failure is not theorem refutation or CounterSatisfiable; no outcome dropped/retried/recapped or fitted by grammar reduction.
success_and_reporting.grouping: Report10case slots and8structural groups separately; renaming controls are correlated tests, never independent new theorem families. For conservative group success require all group members to pass, not whichever rename succeeds.
success_and_reporting.inference: No significance/general superiority/RL benefit from one run per method/case. Prior storage engineering success on a familiar case is not this suite result.
success_and_reporting.primary: Fresh whole Native-accepted proof of the exact target, full selected finite t/m/row verification, complete output/custody and declared resource/terminal gates. Report all three conjuncts separately.
success_and_reporting.secondary: Actual essential UI,GEN,equality,registered-family/cluster use and exact selected-path hint consumption are observations. Ground equality cases need not have UI or GEN; do not require the old UI+GEN milestone for their primary proof success.

primary_sources.source_content_use: Short paraphrases and direct links only. No official theorem/problem/proof file imported, no external prover or online problem-processing service invoked.
